headline: Small bags now keep their tabs on screen when clamped, while the Plain theme improves docking margins and bag button menus.

entries.title: Tabs stay on screen with Clamp Bags to Screen
entries.details: When Clamp Bags to Screen is enabled, small bags placed or dragged near the edge of the screen now keep their tab rail fully visible instead of clipping off-screen.

entries.title: Plain theme docks clear of screen edges
entries.details: Full-height docked panels using the Plain theme now keep an 8-pixel margin clear of the screen top and bottom, preventing frame borders and artwork from extending off-screen.

entries.title: Plain bag button sorting and menu options
entries.details: Right-clicking the bag button in the Plain theme now sorts your items. Its dropdown menu also adds the sort action and a Small Bags toggle across bag, bank, vendor, and guild bank panels.
